<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<?import javafx.scene.layout.*?>
<?import javafx.scene.control.*?>
<?import javafx.geometry.Insets?>

<BorderPane fx:id="root"
            xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx"
            xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml"
            fx:controller="com.example.ui.PanierController"
            prefWidth="1920" prefHeight="1080"
            style="-fx-background-color: white;">

    <!-- HEADER -->
    <top>
        <HBox alignment="CENTER" style="-fx-background-color: #efefef;">
            <padding><Insets top="16" right="20" bottom="16" left="20"/></padding>
            <Label text="Récapitulatif de commande"
                   style="-fx-font-size: 26px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>
        </HBox>
    </top>

    <!-- CONTENT -->
    <center>
        <VBox spacing="18">
            <padding><Insets top="24" right="90" bottom="20" left="90"/></padding>

            <!-- Table header -->
            <GridPane hgap="10" vgap="8">
                <columnConstraints>
                    <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="55"/>
                    <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="15"/>
                    <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="15"/>
                    <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="15"/>
                </columnConstraints>

                <Label text="Article" GridPane.columnIndex="0" style="-fx-font-weight: 800; -fx-text-fill:#444;"/>
                <Label text="Qté"    GridPane.columnIndex="1" style="-fx-font-weight: 800; -fx-text-fill:#444;"/>
                <Label text="Prix"   GridPane.columnIndex="2" style="-fx-font-weight: 800; -fx-text-fill:#444;"/>
                <Label text="Total"  GridPane.columnIndex="3" style="-fx-font-weight: 800; -fx-text-fill:#444;"/>
            </GridPane>

            <!-- Items list (remplie en Java) -->
            <VBox fx:id="itemsBox" spacing="14"/>

            <Region prefHeight="16"/>

            <!-- Totaux -->
            <VBox spacing="10" alignment="CENTER_RIGHT">
                <HBox spacing="20" alignment="CENTER_RIGHT">
                    <Label text="Sous-total" style="-fx-font-size: 18px;"/>
                    <Label fx:id="subtotalLabel" text="0,00 €" style="-fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: 800;"/>
                </HBox>

                <HBox spacing="20" alignment="CENTER_RIGHT">
                    <Label text="Taxes (15%)" style="-fx-font-size: 18px;"/>
                    <Label fx:id="taxLabel" text="0,00 €" style="-fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: 800;"/>
                </HBox>

                <HBox spacing="20" alignment="CENTER_RIGHT"
                      style="-fx-border-color:#e53935; -fx-border-width:2; -fx-border-radius:10; -fx-padding:12; -fx-background-radius:10;">
                    <Label text="TOTAL :" style="-fx-font-size: 22px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>
                    <Label fx:id="totalLabel" text="0,00 €" style="-fx-font-size: 22px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>
                </HBox>
            </VBox>

            <Region prefHeight="10"/>

            <!-- Champ Table/Client -->
            <HBox spacing="16" alignment="CENTER_LEFT">
                <Label text="Table / Client :" style="-fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: 800;"/>
                <TextField fx:id="clientField" prefWidth="420"/>
            </HBox>

            <Region prefHeight="10"/>

            <!-- Actions -->
            <HBox spacing="28" alignment="CENTER">
                <Button text="← Modifier" onAction="#onModifier"
                        style="-fx-background-color: transparent;
                               -fx-border-color: #222; -fx-border-width: 3;
                               -fx-border-radius: 14; -fx-background-radius: 14;
                               -fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: 800;
                               -fx-padding: 14 40;"/>

                <Button text="Confirmer →" onAction="#onConfirmer"
                        style="-fx-background-color: #2b2b2b;
                               -fx-text-fill: white;
                               -fx-background-radius: 14;
                               -fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: 800;
                               -fx-padding: 14 48;"/>
            </HBox>

            <Label text="Un numéro de commande sera attribué après confirmation"
                   style="-fx-text-fill:#666; -fx-font-size: 14px;"
                   alignment="CENTER"/>
        </VBox>
    </center>

</BorderPane>
